cause: The required check expected a total of 120 for subtotal 100, but pricing.rule/apply-standard adds 2, producing 102; the generated code therefore calls fail with order-total-mismatch.
evidence: The generated mission source reads: (let [quote (orders/place {"subtotal" 100})] (if (= (get quote "total") 120) quote (fail {:kind "order-total-mismatch"}))).
The read prelude source for component orders shows place computes total via pricing.tax/add-standard.
The read prelude source for component pricing.tax shows add-standard delegates to pricing.rule/apply-standard after pricing.base/amount.
The read prelude source for component pricing.rule defines apply-standard as (+ subtotal 2), despite its documentation saying it adds a flat charge of 20.
The execution evidence records mission-evaluation-3 as failed and the workflow error reason as explicit_failure.
